mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, process_id, factory_id, workshop_id, production_line_id
mapper.select:
select p.id,p.name,p.product_type from mes_building_team t inner join mes_building_process p on p.id = t.process_id where t.bool_delete_enum = 0
and t.production_line_id = #{productionLineId}

select p.id,p.name,p.product_type from mes_building_team t inner join mes_building_team_user_link tu on tu.team_id = t.id inner join mes_building_process p on p.id = t.process_id where t.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tu.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tu.user_id = #{currentUserId}
and t.production_line_id = #{productionLineId}

SELECT bgr.id groupId, bgr.`name` groupName, taskTeam.id teamId, taskTeam.process_id processId, process.`name` processName, ulink.user_name leaderName FROM mes_building_team taskTeam LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups_team_link groupsLink ON groupsLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND taskTeam.id = groupsLink.team_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups bgr ON bgr.id = groupsLink.groups_id AND bgr.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON taskTeam.process_id = process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link ulink ON taskTeam.id = ulink.team_id AND ulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ulink.bool_leader_enum = 1 WHERE taskTeam.bool_delete_enum = 0 ORDER BY taskTeam.id

SELECT tea.*, link.user_id leaderUserId, link.user_name leaderName, pro.product_type productType FROM mes_building_team tea LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link link ON tea.id = link.team_id AND link.bool_leader_enum = 1 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process pro on tea.process_id = pro.id and pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE tea.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT tea.id id, link.user_id leaderUserId, link.user_name leaderName FROM mes_building_team tea LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link link ON tea.id = link.team_id WHERE tea.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_leader_enum = 1

SELECT mbt.id, mbtul.user_name AS name FROM mes_building_team mbt LEFT JOIn mes_building_team_user_link mbtul ON mbtul.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbtul.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND mbtul.team_id = mbt.id WHERE mbt.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbt.id IN (#{id})
